text:
maria: quick heads-up — kernel v2.14.0-quant landed to staging a few mins ago. planning a quiet-window cutover tonight 23:00 UTC. need: pin TTL, smoke checklist, explicit rollback triggers. cc @devon @lex

devon: thanks — saw build artifacts. can we keep a 10% traffic slice for 30m canary then 50% for 30m before full? prefer staggered regional slices.

lex: +1 on slices. also we should pin older kernel on sticky nodes for 2 hours post-cutover in case we need instant rollback. deploybot supports pinning with TTL.

maria: deploybot call will be: `deploybot cutover --bundle kernel-v2.14.0-quant --canary 10 --canary-duration 1800 --stagger regions` and then `deploybot pin --selector sticky-nodes --ttl 7200` if things look flaky.

sam: QA: regression tests failed once on mem-leak profile during local perf run (non-deterministic). I ran `tests/inference/mem_leak.sh` and saw 1/20 failure. attaching log snippet: `OOM after 18m - kv-cache not released`

qa-ci: failing job: https://ci.redwood/tests/5489 — reproducer attached. We need to decide whether that blocks night cutover.

maria: ok. two options: (A) proceed with conservative canary + auto-rollback on OOM/error-rate>0.5% OR (B) hold until patch. Ops prefers A with tight telemetry gates. thoughts?

devon: prefer A. add these rollback signals: service errors (5xx) spike >0.3%, OOM events >1 per host per 30m, tail-latency P99 increase >30% vs baseline. If any triggered, immediate traffic revert and pin previous kernel.

lex: we need a manual kill switch too. who will own the rollback? ops-team oncall until 01:00 UTC, then runtime-sre. set runbook pointer in the thread.

maria: assigning ownership: @ops-bot is primary automated responder; @devon will be manual oncall until 00:30 UTC, @lex will take 00:30–02:00. I'll update release notes and the rollout doc.

ops-bot: deploybot: cutover job scheduled at 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. preflight checks queued.

devon: preflight checklist: 1) canary image baked (ok), 2) staging smoke (ok), 3) perf baseline snapshot (ok), 4) KV-cache eviction thresholds set (need confirm).

sam: KV-cache eviction thresholds set to `lru_fraction=0.6` on canary hosts. I pushed a debug flag to surface per-request cache hits to tracing.

maria: release notes blurb (draft): "v2.14.0-quant — kernel optimizations for quantized matmul and reduced memory in KV cache. Known issue: intermittent mem-leak under specific sparse attention patterns; telemetry gate active." I'll add link to the canary dashboard.

lex: add explicit rollback play steps to notes: 1) `deploybot revert --to kernel-v2.13.9-stable` 2) `deploybot pin --selector all --ttl 3600` 3) notify customers via status page if >5% traffic affected.

devon: also add metric to alert channel: `infra-kernel-errors` and create a short-term dashboard with delta vs baseline.

maria: ops-bot — pls confirm deploybot dry-run and that pin TTL commands are functional.

ops-bot: deploybot dry-run: PASS. pin command simulated: `deploybot pin --selector sticky-nodes --ttl 7200` -> OK. Canary routing configured: regions eu, na-west, ap-south (staggered).

sam: I'll be on stand-by for 23:00. if we see mem-leak reproducer, I'll collect heap profiles and hold traffic.

devon: agreed. I will watch canary metrics for P99, error-rate, and OOMs. If any rollback triggers, I'll run revert and announce.

maria: final: cutover plan + pinned fallback + rollback criteria documented. proceeding unless someone objects in next 30m. :rocket:
